integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo the explicitly credited Cao-Pan Theorem 2. Finite checking is supplemental, not a proof of quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Exact for positive n only, with no odd-prime analogue proved. The continuous interpolation takes value 2 at index 0, unlike the standard combinatorial S_0=1. The original Cao-Pan shift congruences are assumed as proven literature. No independent audit or general novelty certificate.
title: Exact two-adic valuations and density of consecutive large Schröder-number differences
